<!-- RESEARCH AREAS -->
<div class="section-wrap section-wrap--surface">
  <div class="section-inner">
    <div class="eyebrow">Research</div>
    <h2 class="section-title">Three open questions</h2>
    <p class="section-sub">We study receptor-binding proteins (RBPs) in <em>Klebsiella pneumoniae</em> phages — the proteins that determine which bacteria a phage can infect, and the primary drivers of host-range evolution.</p>
    <div class="cards-grid">
      <div class="research-card">
        <div class="card-area">Area 01</div>
        <div class="card-title">Genetic &amp; structural diversity</div>
        <div class="card-body">What RBP diversity exists? We catalogue and characterise RBPs computationally at sequence and structural scale.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="research-card">
        <div class="card-area">Area 02</div>
        <div class="card-title">Functional diversity &amp; breadth</div>
        <div class="card-body">How does sequence map to function? The relationship is more complex than assumed — many RBPs are enzymes, the activity and specificity of which against polysaccharides is hard to predict.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="research-card">
        <div class="card-area">Area 03</div>
        <div class="card-title">Adaptation via innovation</div>
        <div class="card-body">How does domain and sub-domain recombination generate new RBP functions and structures? We trace the evolutionary paths by which phages adapt to new hosts.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <a class="section-more" href="research.html">Full research overview →</a>
  </div>
</div>

```{r pubs}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| cache: false

source("parse_bib.R")

featured_keys <- c("Otwinowska2025depocatalog", "Otwinowska2025temperate", "Ndovie2025msystems")
pubs <- parse_bib("publications.bib")
names(pubs) <- sapply(pubs, function(p) p$key)

highlight_pi <- function(s) {
  gsub("(Mostowy,\\s+Rafa[łl]?\\s*(?:J\\.?)?|Mostowy,\\s+Rafal\\s*(?:J\\.?)?)",
       '<span class="pi">\\1</span>', s, perl = TRUE)
}

cards <- ""
for (key in featured_keys) {
  p <- pubs[[key]]
  if (is.null(p)) next
jl    <- tolower(p$journal %||% "")
  jname <- p$journal %||% ""
  doi   <- if (nchar(p$doi %||% "") > 0)
             sprintf(' <a class="pub-doi" href="https://doi.org/%s" target="_blank">doi &#8594;</a>', p$doi)
           else ""
  badge <- if (grepl("biorxiv", jl))
             '<span class="pub-badge badge-preprint">Preprint</span>'
           else
             sprintf('<span class="pub-badge badge-published">%s</span>', jname)
  cards <- paste0(cards,
    '<div class="pub-card">',
      '<div>',
        '<div class="pub-badges">', badge, '</div>',
        '<div class="pub-title">', p$title %||% "", '</div>',
        '<div class="pub-authors">', highlight_pi(p$author %||% ""), '</div>',
        '<div class="pub-journal"><em>', jname, '</em>', doi, '</div>',
      '</div>',
      '<div class="pub-year-big">', p$year %||% "", '</div>',
    '</div>\n'
  )
}

knitr::asis_output(paste0(
  '<div class="section-wrap section-wrap--white">',
  '<div class="section-inner">',
  '<div class="eyebrow">Publications</div>',
  '<h2 class="section-title">Selected recent papers</h2>',
  '<div class="pub-list">', cards, '</div>',
  '<a class="section-more" href="publications.html">All publications &#8594;</a>',
  '</div></div>'
))
```
